- [USER] User asked about the impact of the Bauhaus movement on modern design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bauhaus movement impacted modern design by promoting functionality, integration of art and technology, minimalism and simplicity, and experimentation and innovation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bauhaus movement emphasized functionality over purely decorative designs, leading to sleek and simple designs that are efficient and practical.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bauhaus movement integrated art and technology, leading to the development of new materials like steel and glass used in modern buildings and products.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bauhaus movement promoted minimalism and simplicity, resulting in clean lines, geometric shapes, and a focus on form over ornamentation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Bauhaus movement encouraged experimentation and innovation in design, leading to new techniques and methods still used in modern design today.
